title: Cooking with polluting fuels
question: How many people cook with coal, wood, dung, crop waste or kerosene?
metric: Share of the population relying mainly on polluting fuels and technologies for cooking

source.citation: World Health Organization. Global Health Observatory: proportion of population with primary reliance on polluting fuels and technologies for cooking (indicator PHE_HHAIR_PROP_POP_POLLUTING_FUELS).
source.licence: WHO Global Health Observatory data, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO (WHO data policy)

caveats: Coal smoke indoors is a known cause of lung cancer (IARC Group 1); wood smoke indoors is a probable cause (Group 2A). This layer combines all polluting fuels; WHO does not publish the coal share openly by country.
